objective: T-20260929-10 (owner research-list item 3): test a long-only ETP version of Zarattini/Mele/Aziz's dual-VIX-signal volatility risk premium strategy (SSRN 5316487 / SFI RP 25-91). Signal 1: eVRP = VIX - annualized 10-day realized SPY volatility. Signal 2: VIX vs VIX3M term structure. When the original signal says short-vol, hold SVXY sized at VIX/100 (capped <=1); otherwise hold SPY or SHY (two remainder variants tested). No short selling, no VIXY/UVXY long-vol leg (both forbidden by the brief) -- this simplifies the paper's 4-case logic (which longs VIXY in the 'full long-vol conviction' case) to a 2-state long-only rule, tested against K1/K2/watch_recent under the frozen screen_lane contract, and against a static 50/50 SMH/QQQ hold.

cost_and_execution_assumptions: Unchanged screen_lane contract: signal at bar close, fill at next bar open, 10bp primary / 20bp stress per side, weights_fn reads close.loc[:asof] only (VIX/VIX3M CSVs are read the same way -- asof-truncated, no look-ahead -- inside the candidate module, following h20260928_18_vix_putw.py's external-CSV-read convention). Position sizing: weight = min(1.0, VIX_t/100) (full short-vol case) or min(1.0, 0.5*VIX_t/100) (half-size case), applied to SVXY; remainder to SPY (in the *_SPY candidates) or to SHY via the harness's own automatic cash remainder (in the *_SHY candidates, which return only the SVXY leg and let screen_lane.weights_frame top up to SHY -- SHY is a cash substitute here per the brief, not a cross-asset return source).
stop_condition: K1: median-offset (n/a here, freq='D' so no offset sweep -- see search-space.md) net-10bp anchor Sharpe >=1.19 and stress Sharpe >=0.65, and net-20bp CAGR positive in both windows, for at least one non-placebo, non-static-control candidate. K2: diversifier judged_edge (S3+candidate inverse-vol blend vs vol-matched S3+SHY control) >=0.05 in both anchor and stress windows. watch_recent: anchor Sharpe >=1.19 but stress unmet. Strong keep: K2 edge >=0.10, or K1 met in both windows at or above S3's own 1.49/0.81. Falsification: any candidate that clears K1/K2 must beat its own RAND placebo's anchor Sharpe and the static 50/50 SMH/QQQ control's anchor Sharpe; if it does not, demote to 'not kept (placebo/benchmark replication)', same convention as h20260929_01_letf_flow_reversal's keep_rule.

sources.claim: Independent from-scratch QuantConnect backtest of Zarattini/Aziz/Mele (2025)'s dual-VIX-signal strategy. eVRP_t = VIX_t - eRV30_t, eRV30 = std(trailing ~10 daily SPY returns, ddof=1) * sqrt(252) * 100. Signal 2 is VIX vs VIX3M. Four cases mapped to a target_weight on VIXY: (1) eVRP>0 & VIX<VIX3M -> target_weight=-VIX/100 (full short-vol); (2) eVRP<0 & VIX<VIX3M -> target_weight=-0.5*VIX/100 (half short-vol); (3) eVRP<0 & VIX>VIX3M -> target_weight=+VIX/100 (full long-vol); (4) else -> target_weight=0 (cash). Remaining capital held in SPY only while short-vol (cases 1/2); fully cash otherwise. Backtested 2016-01 to 2026-07: Sharpe 0.729 vs SPY buy-and-hold Sharpe 0.582. Parameter grid (RV window 6-14 days x rebalance threshold 1-5%, 25 combos) all beat SPY's Sharpe, range 0.713-0.773; grid mean 0.746, max 0.773 at (14-day window, 3% threshold); default (10-day, 2%) gives the reported 0.729.
sources.applicability: Primary source for this iteration's signal formulas, case logic and VIX/100 position-sizing rule; our long-only-ETP version drops case 3 (long-vol) entirely (no VIXY/UVXY long leg permitted by the brief) and expresses the short-vol leg on SVXY (1x weight = VIX/100, not QC's suggested 2x SVXY-beta-matching) instead of short VIXY.
sources.limitations: Not the original paper -- an independent third-party replication, not the paywalled SSRN full text. Uses VIXY, not SVXY, as its tradable short-vol instrument; the paper's own precise 'Strategy 3 vs Strategy 4' sizing distinction is only known through this secondary source.
sources.independent_replication: Cross-checked against concretum_group_volatility_edge_blog (author-affiliated summary, reports/harness/source_cards/h20260929_10_vix_vrp_etp.jsonl -- not bound in this strict sources list since matching a literal quote in its own snapshot to the schema's fetch/hash-binding rules was not attempted) and a WebSearch snippet of the SSRN abstract page (papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5316487, blocked on direct curl/WebFetch -- full text UNREAD, also not bound here) -- both report a materially positive Sharpe/CAGR from the same 2-signal mechanism over a different (2008-2025) window.
